meta.description: DB28 ultra-quiet smart curtain motor: 27.2 dB, brushless with no carbon dust, 2 N·m of torque for 12 m and 100 kg curtains, control by the percent on MixPad and a 10-year motor warranty.

tiles.name: DB28 Ultra-quiet Curtain Motor
sec2.title: No carbon dust, the king of quiet
sec2.desc: When the curtains close on their own late at night, the only sound you hear is your baby breathing.
sec3.desc: *Measured by a national electrical product quality supervision and testing center: 27.2 dB. Test report No. WTS2022-3838.
sec4.title: Starts silently, for peaceful sleep
sec4.desc: Twin drive bearings lower the power and current the motor needs to start. With timed starts, it starts silently at bedtime and closes the curtains gently, so nothing disturbs your sleep.
sec4.desc2: The Italian MEGADYNE drive belt, its teeth spaced to within 0.01 mm, meshes with the gearbox with zero gap for smooth running without rattles. Made of special polyurethane, it is supple, resists stretching and keeps its shape for 20 years.
sec6.title: No carbon buildup, a healthier home
sec6.desc: The brushless motor makes no carbon dust, so it stays healthy over years of use. Motors with carbon brushes shed carbon powder as they run; breathed in heavily, or by sensitive people, it can cause a lung disease similar to pneumoconiosis.
sec7.title: Opening set by the percent, steplessly
sec7.desc: Forget the old button remote: with an intuitive slider on MixPad, the DB28 opens the curtains exactly as far as you set, so you decide how bright the room is.
sec8.title: High torque opens heavy curtains with ease
sec8.desc: 2 N·m of torque pulls 12 m of curtain with ease and carries up to 100 kg, so even the heaviest villa curtains are no trouble.
sec9.title:
Titanium-grey
aerospace aluminum,
made to be seen
sec9.desc: A titanium-grey finish on aerospace aluminum, brushed and anodized: refined, smooth and rich to the touch.
sec10.item_desc: Vertical e-coating keeps the paint from pooling inside the rail, so the curtains glide smoothly, without snags or noise.
sec10.item_desc2: A star-shaped output shaft grips the gearbox with 8 teeth, so the curtain runs without slipping or rattling. Made of zinc alloy, far stronger than the plastic most of the industry uses, it lasts 20 years without replacement.
sec10.item_desc3: With no carbon brushes wearing the motor, it lasts up to 20,000 hours, four times the industry's 5,000-hour ceiling. And beyond the usual 5-year limit, the motor carries a 10-year warranty, for worry-free ownership.
